## Regression: bag of words

The simple, bag-of-words (BoW) setup isolates the noise-robustness of supervised-learning (SL), reinforce (RL), GRPO, and MaxRL in a **zero-step rollout** setting.

### Dataset

A BoW dataset is parameterized by a signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) knob.
